easter-egg:8.text: This location is situated east of Brandywine Drop and north of Roanoke Valley. The Meteor House is a cabin on a cliff that overlooks Roanoke Valley in Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover. This point of interest features a stone cottage and a small outhouse behind it. Surrounding the house are things such as a shovel, a bundle of firewood, barrels and other gardening tools. The property is encircled by a wooden fence.
